messages.content: nepal ma kati pradesh chhan? sabai ko naam bhana
nepal ma 7 pradesh chhan: koshi, madhesh, bagmati, gandaki, lumbini, karnali ra sudurpashchim.
gandaki pradesh ko rajdhani kun ho?
gandaki pradesh ko rajdhani pokhara ho.
koshi pradesh ko rajdhani?
koshi pradesh ko rajdhani biratnagar ho.
karnali ko rajdhani k ho?
karnali pradesh ko rajdhani birendranagar (surkhet) ho.
madhesh pradesh ko rajdhani kaha chha?
madhesh pradesh ko rajdhani janakpur ho.
sudurpashchim ko rajdhani?
sudurpashchim pradesh ko rajdhani godawari (kailali) ho.
sagarmatha kati aglo chha?
sagarmatha 8848.86 meter aglo chha. yo sansar ko sabai bhanda aglo himal ho ra nepal ra china ko simana ma parchha.
gautam buddha kaha janmanubhayeko ho?
gautam buddha lumbini ma janmanubhayeko ho, jun aahile nepal ko rupandehi jilla ma parchha. lumbini UNESCO world heritage site pani ho.
dashain kina manauchhan?

dashain ma durga mata le mahishasur mathi gareko bijaya ko samjhana garinchha, arthat asatya mathi satya ko jit. tika, jamara, thula haru ko ashirbad, pariwar sanga bhet ra ping dashain ka mukhya kura hun.
tihar ma k k garinchha?

tihar 5 din ko chad ho: kag tihar, kukur tihar, gai tihar ra laxmi puja, goru puja (mha puja pani sangai), ani bhai tika. ghar ma diyo balinchha, deusi bhailo khelinchha, ra didi bahini le bhai lai saptarangi tika lagaidinchhan.
chhath parva kaha dherai manauchhan?
chhath mukhya rupma madhesh ma, khas gari maithil, bhojpuri ra tharu samudaya le dherai manauchhan. yasma surya lai nadi ya pokhari ko kinara ma arghya diinchha.
losar k ho?

losar bhaneko naya barsha ho. tamu losar gurung samudaya le, sonam losar tamang samudaya le ra gyalpo losar sherpa samudaya le manauchhan. naach, gaan, khana ra pariwar sanga bhet losar ka mukhya kura hun.
teej ma mahila haru k garchhan?
teej ma mahila haru rato luga lagayera naachgaan garchhan, ra dherai le shiva parbati ko puja garera barta basnchhan. dar khane, sathi ra maiti sanga bhetghat garne parampara pani chha.
nepal ko rashtriya phool ra chara k ho?
nepal ko rashtriya phool lali gurans ho ra rashtriya chara danphe ho.
nepal ko sabai bhanda lamo nadi kun ho?
nepal bhitra sabai bhanda lamo nadi karnali ho. koshi, gandaki ra karnali nepal ka teen thula nadi pranali hun.
nepal ma kati bhasa bolinchha?
2078 ko janaganana anusar nepal ma 120 bhanda badhi matribhasa bolinchhan. nepali sabai bhanda dherai bolinchha, tyaspachhi maithili, bhojpuri, tharu, tamang, newar lagayat.
kathmandu upatyaka ma kun kun jilla parchhan?
kathmandu upatyaka ma 3 jilla parchhan: kathmandu, lalitpur ra bhaktapur.
nepal ko rashtriya janawar?
nepal ko rashtriya janawar gai ho.
pashupatinath kaha chha?
pashupatinath mandir kathmandu ma bagmati nadi ko kinara ma chha. yo hindu haru ko pramukh shiva mandir ho ra UNESCO world heritage site ko bhag ho.
nepal ko ganatantra kahile bhayo?
nepal 2065 saal jestha 15 gate (sanu 2008 may 28) ma sanghiya loktantrik ganatantra ghosana bhayo. tyasaile jestha 15 lai ganatantra diwas bhanchhan.
dal bhat tarkari kina nepal ma lokpriya chha?

dal bhat tarkari sasto, pet bharne ra poshilo chha: bhat le urja, dal le protein ra tarkari le vitamin dinchha. din ma dui palta khane chalan le gardaa 'dal bhat power, 24 hour' bhanne kura pani chalchha.
nepal ko jhanda ko aakar kasto chha?
nepal ko jhanda sansar ma ekmatra charkune nabhayeko jhanda ho: dui ota tribhuj ek mathi arko jodiyeko. rato rang ma nilo kinara chha, mathi chandrama ra tala surya ko chinha chha.
